extraction.Name: Elizabeth Janis
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 160 acre allotment, but that they mailed it to her, and she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it to Mr. James Basinger, of Interior, South Dakota, for $1200.00, cash
extraction.Buyer: Mr. James Basinger, of Interior, South Dakota, for $1200.00, cash
extraction.Occupation/Income: supports herself by her seamstress work, also, does work at household duties whenever she can get it
extraction.NOTES: Sold in 1920; mentally competent, has very good health, except being troubled with her heart; single, with no one to support, except that until quite recently she had helped to support her mother, who is just married; has never received any help from the County or United States Government; document sworn November 19, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota
